translation.name: Nasoruan siGot len nasoruan ta Uluveu

book.name: Rom
book.title: Rom Nalob̃ulat napisulan aPol totosi van hǝn alat a Rom

content: Naviolan hǝn natutumavan tomaur

Imagenan, bathudud nadǝlomian, husur nǝlon aGot totaŋis gidato, noŋir gamito ke: Viol hǝn nibemito mai aGot hum naviolan hǝn natutumavan tomaur, hǝn b̃evi esan sǝb̃on, hǝn gai b̃ehǝhaṽur masuṽ hǝni. Enan evi nap̃isal kitin hǝn mǝtb̃ilotu hǝn aGot.

Samtigol tǝtoṽ hǝn naṽide gail hǝn navile eg a pan. Be aGot tegǝgel hǝn gamito; tegǝgel hǝn nap̃isal hǝn nǝnauan samito hǝn b̃iveveu. B̃imaienan, dereh mitinau kitev nǝsa aGot tolǝŋoni, mǝtelǝboi sǝhoti, hǝn mǝtb̃igol nǝsa tovoi, nǝsa tonor, nǝsa togol aGot tohǝhaṽur hǝni.

Len navoian aGot toviol kǝmas hǝni mai ginau, nukele hǝn gamit ṽisusua ke, saginau gaiug gabag tesǝhor nakitinan husur gaiug. Be len natibauan o nakǝkerehan hǝn nadǝlomian aGot tolav mai gamit ṽisusua, mitinau kot nakitinan hǝn gamit sǝb̃omito.
Niben nǝvanuan ikad nahudhute isob̃ur, ale nahudhut ṽisusua ikad nauman san totile.
Imaienan hǝn alat lotoriŋ nǝlolit len aYesu. Gidat dattosob̃ur datovi niben tosua len aKristo. Ale gidat ṽisusua datovi sidat gabag.
Datukad naviolan tiltile gail lotonor hǝn navoian aGot toviol kǝmas hǝni mai gidato. Gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn gǝb̃ikel ur nǝsa aGot tokel mai gaiug, gikel ur napisulan siGot tinor hǝn nadǝlomian sam̃.
Gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn gǝb̃evi tarhǝt sinǝvanuan gail, gevi tarhǝt salito. Gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn gǝb̃ep̃usan, gep̃usan.

Gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn gǝb̃igol nǝvanuan gail lǝb̃elǝŋon b̃ivoi am len nǝlolito, gigol lelǝŋon tivoi am len nǝlolito. Gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn gǝb̃eviol, geviol habat. Gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn na-il-a-m̃o-an, len na-il-a-m̃o-an sam̃ geum tivoi. Ale gǝb̃ikad naviolan hǝn nǝlom̃ b̃itaŋis nǝvanuan gail, gigole len nahǝhaṽuran.
Na-lǝmas-buni-an satevi nagǝgǝrasan, timaskitin. Mǝtahun bun natideh tosa len nabunusian siGot. Tǝgau gat nǝsa tovoi len nabunusian siGot.
Lǝmas masuṽ hǝn gamit gabag hum mǝttovi alatmiṽan. Putsan gamit gabag len nǝnauan samito sǝhor gamit sǝb̃omito.
Sagipetǝmas len nauman siGot be timaur mǝtam̃ hum aNunun aGot toṽuv vivi mǝhat len nǝlom̃.
Bathut nǝ-vatvat-viri-an gotokade len aGot, gehǝhaṽur. Nǝboŋ na-lǝŋon-isa-vǝsa-an b̃ibar gaiug, gidaŋ b̃uri len na-toh-mǝdau-an sam̃. Gidaŋ len na-sor-tuṽ-an.
Nǝboŋ nǝvanuan siGot lǝb̃em̃idol, gevi tarhǝt salito. Gehǝhaṽur hǝn nametb̃os gail lǝb̃eb̃is lohoim sam̃.
Geus aGot hǝn b̃ivoi hǝn alat lotomǝdas gaiug gol gotolǝŋon tosa vǝsa. Geusi hǝn b̃ivoi hǝn galito, sageusi hǝn b̃emǝdas galito.
Gehǝhaṽur mai alat lotohǝhaṽur. Gelǝŋon tisa, gitaŋ mai alat lotolǝŋon tosa, lototaŋ.

Mitinau gamit gabag hum mǝttop̃itoṽ ŋai. Sagipatpat gaiug mǝhat len nǝnauan sam̃, be gehǝhaṽur hǝn gǝb̃itah mai alat lotovi ut kǝmas. Len nǝnauan sam̃ sǝb̃om̃ saginau ke gotokad namitisau hǝn nǝmauran tonor.
Sagivar tǝlmam hǝn nǝsaan van hǝn avan ideh togol tosa hǝn gaiug. Len natideh gǝb̃igole, gol husur nap̃isal nǝvanuan p̃isi lotolǝboi lǝb̃ekǝta sǝhoti ke tovoi.
Len natideh topat len gaiug, gǝb̃elǝboi gǝb̃igole, gikad natǝm̃at mai nǝvanuan p̃isi.

Gamit notolǝmas bun gamit p̃isi, samtigol nasisilan. Riŋi hǝn nǝlol paŋpaŋ tonor siGot b̃igole. Bathut len natosian, Nasub̃ aGot ike, “Nasisilan ipat len ginau. Ginau dereh nipansem alat lotogol tosa hǝn gamito, ipat len ginau.”
Be hum natosian siGot tokele am ke, “Naenemi sam̃ b̃imalkǝkat, gevǝŋani. B̃imaduh, lav natideh maii hǝn b̃emuni. Nǝboŋ gǝb̃igol natenan, nahurun dereh tisa masuṽ.”
Nǝsaan satesǝhor gaiug; be gesǝhor nǝsaan hǝn navoian.
